m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read this skill's references/global-crew.md and references/global-everyone.md, then docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md and docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, plus .agent-work/513-fp-fits/handoff-g2.md and GATE_PROTOCOL.md. Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions); confirm src/physics/mass_model.py and src/physics/layer2/session_race.py (the reuse pattern) read cleanly. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew context + glossary + handoff + session_race read pattern loaded; handoff complete

m1-fp-mass.title: fp_mass distribution contract in mass_model.py
m1-fp-mass.imperative: Add FpMass NamedTuple (mass_kg, sigma_kg), NOMINAL_FP_FUEL_KG, FP_FUEL_INTERCEPT_SIGMA_KG constants, and fp_mass(season, *, fuel_kg=None, fuel_sigma_kg=None, team=None) -> FpMass to src/physics/mass_model.py per handoff-g2.md close criteria (mass_kg = SEASON_BASE_KG[season] + fuel_kg + team_offset; sigma_kg reflects fuel uncertainty; None fuel_kg uses NOMINAL_FP_FUEL_KG + FP_FUEL_INTERCEPT_SIGMA_KG). Do NOT touch quali_mass/race_mass. Write failing tests FIRST in tests/unit/physics/test_mass_model.py (FpMass shape, default distribution, explicit fuel_kg/sigma override, negative-value ValueError, unknown-season KeyError, invariant SEASON_BASE_KG[season] < mass_kg < quali_mass(season)+MAX_FUEL_KG). Attest c1 (red observed) BEFORE implementing, then implement and get c2 green.

postconditions.statement: TDD red: new fp_mass/FpMass tests written and observed failing (ImportError/AttributeError) — manual attest

constraints: named tunable constants with docstrings flagging calibration placeholders

m2-run-purpose.title: classify_run_purpose pure function
m2-run-purpose.imperative: In new src/physics/layer2/fp_lap_latent.py, add classify_run_purpose(...) -> str classifying a lap into {out, push, in, long_run} EMERGENTLY from lap_time-vs-session-best and pit/stint position (never from a session-type label). Add PUSH_MARGIN_FRAC and any other named tunable constants used, docstring-flagged as calibration placeholders. Write failing tests FIRST in new tests/unit/physics/test_fp_lap_latent.py covering out/in/push/long_run classification, boundary cases (single-lap stint, missing lap_time), determinism. Attest c1 (red) then implement to green (c2).

postconditions.statement: TDD red: classify_run_purpose tests written and observed failing — manual attest

constraints: run_purpose classification is pure and deterministic, no DB/IO
no session-type label as an input

m3-fp-lap-latent.title: extract_fp_lap_latent DB extractor + FpLapLatent + fuel_kg_est
m3-fp-lap-latent.imperative: Add FpLapLatent dataclass, fuel_kg_est(lap_in_stint, run_purpose, ...) (start_fuel-by-run_purpose minus burn*lap_in_stint, floored at reserve; burn from mass_model.DEFAULT_BURN_PER_LAP_KG), START_FUEL_PUSH_KG/START_FUEL_LONGRUN_KG/FP_FUEL_RESERVE_KG named constants, and extract_fp_lap_latent(year, gp, session_type, *, db_path, driver=None) -> list[FpLapLatent] to src/physics/layer2/fp_lap_latent.py, mirroring session_race.py's _get_session_id / read-only sqlite pattern for lap_times (add lap_time to the selected columns; compound read directly from lap_times.compound, never inferred). Each lap's mass_kg/mass_sigma_kg comes from mass_model.fp_mass(year, fuel_kg=..., fuel_sigma_kg=...). Write failing tests FIRST in tests/unit/physics/test_fp_lap_latent.py using an in-memory/tmp_path sqlite fixture (NEVER a real data/*.db) with a synthetic session+lap_times covering a push lap and a long-run lap. Attest c1 (red) then implement to green (c2).

postconditions.statement: TDD red: extract_fp_lap_latent tests written and observed failing — manual attest
extract_fp_lap_latent implemented; tests pass; no real data/*.db read

constraints: tests use tmp_path/in-memory sqlite only, never data/*.db

m4-evidence.title: Full evidence pass: combined tests, value table, simplification limits
m4-evidence.imperative: Run the full required-evidence test command (both test files together), produce a push-lap-vs-long-run-lap fp_mass value table for 2023 (mass ordering + sigma) using extract-level constants, and run py -m src.utils.simplification_limits --paths on the two touched/new src files. Confirm git status shows no data/*.db changes. Attest c1 with all evidence captured.

preconditions.statement: fp_mass, classify_run_purpose, extract_fp_lap_latent all green individually

postconditions.statement: combined suite green; value table produced; simplification-limits run; data/ clean

check.command: cd /c/Programs/f1-513 && PYTHONPATH=/c/Programs/f1-513 py -m pytest tests/unit/physics/test_mass_model.py tests/unit/physics/test_fp_lap_latent.py -q
